title: Rav Achdevoi, Brother of Mar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 111a. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Achdevoi bar Ami; Hyman reports that all the old printings have Rav Acha, brother of Mar Acha, and so it is in Seder HaDorot under the entry Rav Acha.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text places Achdevoi, brother of Mar Acha, at Shabbat 111b; Hyman supplies 111a. Hyman’s reported old-printing forms and printing-history explanation are kept as his report, without claiming those pages were inspected.

The consulted Shabbat 111b paragraph names Achdevoi, brother of Mar Acha. The separately consulted 111a paragraph concerns Acha Arikha. Hyman’s supplied 111a and his old-printing, Dikdukei Soferim, and Seder HaDorot reports remain literal reports, without a new collation or silent locator correction.
